triggerAriaPrivate: Private agent. Change who can see this agent
linePrivate: Only you can see and use it in Agenta.
lineProject: Everyone in {{project}} can see and use it. Chats with it stay private: share each chat from its own Share button.
makePrivateBody: Other members will no longer see or run this agent in Agenta. They can still read the chats they already had with it, but they cannot send to them. If you connected it to a channel, it keeps answering everyone there.
transferHelp: Only members of this project can own the agent.
transferPrivateWarning: This agent is private. After the transfer only {{name}} can see it, and you lose access. You cannot undo this yourself.
transferPrivateChats: Your chats with this agent stay yours. You can read them, but you cannot send to them.
transferShared: {{name}} will decide who can see this agent. You will no longer be able to make it private or change its owner.
transferInvalid: {{name}} is no longer a member of this project. Pick someone else.
notOwner: Only {{owner}} can make this agent private or change its owner.
ownerLeft: {{owner}} left this project, so this agent has no owner. It stays shared with the project.
ownerLeftNonAdmin: A project admin can take ownership.
ownerLeftAskAdmin: {{owner}} left this project, so this agent has no owner. It stays shared with the project. A project admin can take ownership.
noOwner: An API key or an automation created this agent, so it has no owner and is shared with the project.
takeOwnershipHelp: You become the owner and can make it private.
ownerActive: {{owner}} is a member of this project again, so you cannot take ownership.
conflict: The privacy or owner of this agent changed while you had this open. We loaded the latest settings. Check them and try again.
saveFailed: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
loadError: Couldn't load the privacy settings of this agent.
channelsOff: This agent no longer answers in {{platforms}}. Turn {{platforms}} back on in Channels.
toastShared: {{agent}} is now shared with the project.
